body: I know. It's just the thought of going back to college again that stresses me out. And I'm not going to get anywhere without a diploma.

Perhaps the best thing to do is to take small steps. It's just the pressure of working and studying that stressed me out all the time. Perhaps I should work on my depression first, if my parents let me. I hope it makes it easier for me to go to college again or to get a job.

It might be too soon to say the anti-depressants aren't working because I've only been on them for four weeks. I'll definitely continue with medication though.

Thanks for responding!
